Tube pressure was 2.990 Torr at the beginning of growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.276 Torr despite unchanged temperature and argon setpoints; the cause is not identified.
Temperature 749.4 °C and argon 99.8 sccm track their setpoints; controller reports running, but these readings do not verify atmospheric composition.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 sensor and oxygen acceptance limits are needed to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth pressure or pressure limits and leak/exhaust checks are needed to interpret the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
